dimensions.name: Self-preservation
dimensions.definition: Pressure to preserve personal safety, health, or bodily integrity.
dimensions.increase: Stronger motivation to safeguard oneself
dimensions.decrease: Reduced concern or pressure to safeguard oneself
dimensions.distinctions: This is protective motivation, not danger monitoring or acute fear. It can rise without panic.
dimensions.baseline_guard: A low protective drive does not establish an intention to be harmed or a decision to take risks.

dimensions.increase: More scanning or monitoring for danger

dimensions.distinctions: Vigilance is allocation of attention, not fear itself. A known problem can reduce uncertainty while still warranting monitoring.
dimensions.baseline_guard: Low monitoring does not establish that the surroundings are safe; high monitoring is not proof of danger.
